title: Te Whakamātautau o te Mura Tapu
intro: I tētahi whenua tawhito i reira kua pūmau te aroha ki ngā kōhatu whakairo i roto i ngā kāinga katoa, kotahi te tangata i tū motuhake. Nā te whakapono pumau me te tiaki a te Atua, i tūtaki rātou ki te mea i tika kia mate - ā, i haere atu rātou me te kore whara. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri o tēnei wairua whakamiharo?
clues: I whakatipuria ahau i roto i te hunga i piko ki ngā whakapakoko i whakairohia e ō rātou ake ringa, i te whakapono he mana atua kei roto i ēnei taonga.
I taku whakahē i ō rātou whakapono, i te tuatahi ka whakakorekore rātou i ahau, engari kāore i taea e au te noho puku mō te pono i mōhiotia e au.
I te rā i huihuia mai ai rātou, i whakangaromia e ahau ā rātou whakapakoko, ā, ko te mea nui rawa i mahue iho, kāore i pāngia.
I tō rātou hokinga mai, ka kite i taku i mahi ai, ka whakahaua e ō rātou kaiārahi kia hanga he tahunga nui, i te whakaaro kia maka ahau ki roto i te mura.
I maka ahau e rātou ki roto i te ahi mura, engari i whakahau te Ariki o ngā ao kia matao, kia haumaru hoki mōku.
I puta mai ahau i roto i te mura, kāore he whara i pā ki ahau, ko te hunga i whakatakoto whakaaro mōku i tūtaki ki te whakangaromanga rawa.
